Subject: 20% off headlamps — this weekend only
Preview: 400 lumens, 40-hour runtime, 95 g. Your next trip just got a little lighter.
Body: You've been out there recently, so you know what a headlamp actually needs to do.

This weekend, we're offering 20% off the Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05) — no code needed, available through Sunday.

Here's what it does:

• 400 lumens of output — enough for trail running, camp chores, or a predawn start on a technical approach.
• Up to 40 hours of runtime on a single charge, so a multi-night trip won't leave you rationing light.
• USB-C rechargeable — one cable, no proprietary adapters.
• 95 g on your head. Light enough that you stop noticing it.

A note on limits: the Beacon is built for general backcountry and camping use. It's not rated for diving or submersion, and the 40-hour runtime is measured at reduced output — expect fewer hours at full 400 lumens.

If you've been thinking about picking one up or adding a backup to your kit, this weekend is a straightforward time to do it.
